title: MessageEnvelope
description: Uniform AMQP message envelope shared by the Java backend and the Python agent service.

schemaVersion.description: Protocol version. Consumers must reject unsupported major versions.

messageId.description: Unique message identifier, used for message-level deduplication.

correlationId.description: Groups all messages produced by one logical business operation.

causationId.description: messageId of the direct upstream message that caused this one.

spanId.description: The span of the producer. The consumer continues the trace as its child.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation time with millisecond precision.

producer.description: Service name that produced the message.
